strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed. 2. Victory conditions not met within 12 turns.
Oh...? So you made it in time. As expected of Londo Bell.
I hear they fought Glemy Toto as well as me...
Brushing off two interceptions... They're not to be underestimated.
We've finally made it this far...!
Tch, their mobile suits are all new models or tough ones.
Looks like taking that detour to build up our forces was the right call.
We can't say that just yet. ...It cost us precious time.
We're heading out. Captain, how long do we have?
12 minutes... That's all.
12 minuuutes!?
You're joking, Bright!
If I could joke at a time like this, I'd be either the finest captain
or the biggest fool in space.
...12 minutes left. Crying or laughing won't change that...!
If it won't change, then we just finish them off in that time.
This will be a tough fight...
Let's go, Koji!
Okay, Daisuke! We gotta fill the gap the others left, too.
Things seem crazy on the ground too, so... we can't complain, but it's rough.
Tetsuya, time is short... let's go!
Right, let's go, Daisuke. We'll settle this by breaking straight through.
We have to fill the gap left by the team that went down to Earth, too.
I hate mobile suits. My attacks never hit 'em.
This is no time to whine, Kappei!
Anyway, we shut those weirdo enemies up.
We'd better clean up here fast, or they might come back.
Ya never know when those guys are gonna show up, huh.
The moment of truth. Stardust... I will see it through...!
That new mobile armor... It can't be...!
That Doven Wolf over there... Those moves, is that Mashymre!?
The Gandor team's doing their best on the ground. I have to... Hm!?
Hm? Hibiki, what's wrong? We're launching.
...No... Raideen is... telling me something?
Akira! Isn't this... bad?
Excellen, could it be... you too!?
...Yes. A bad feeling... And not a normal one, somehow...
What are you doing!? All hands, launch!
Gato!
A mobile armor!? The Federation's new model... So you're the pilot!
I won't let you drop that colony!
Can you stop it!? 12 more minutes... After that, it will hit Earth!
I won't let you have your way...! Gato!
A colony drop with so few troops... Times certainly do change.
But I can't let them do it...!
All units, attack! Don't let them near the colony!
Tch, not bad...
Heh... Go on, let's see how long you can keep struggling!
Gah, curse you, not again...! No choice, I'm bailing out!
A direct hit! Now...
...It can't move anymore, it seems.
Running away...!? Wait! Who are you... no, what do you want!?
What do you have to do with me and Kyosuke...
Kyo...suke...? Kyosuke... my... that person is...
You're being pushed back pretty hard.
The Nightmare of Solomon and the Rose Knight... not so impressive, eh?
...!! That's...!? The Gundam GP02A!
What!? Who's piloting it!?
Of all the times...!
The Delaz Fleet...! They're aces, no doubt about it.
They know how to fight...!
Gundam Unit 2... A fine machine.
It's the same Gundam series as my Gerbera. Fits like a glove.
You jerk, you were hiding close by!
You were waiting for your chance!? Sneaking around!
Lieutenant Colonel Cima Garahau...! You're late! What kept you!
Heh... Surprise attacks matter most when you've got a big gun.
Let's go, you lot!
Dammit, these guys are a pain!
That one gives off a nasty pressure... I won't let them get in Judau's way!
Yikes, here they come!
Hey, don't chicken out, Boss!
Some ace in the hole. A nuke on top of a colony drop... They're insane.
Seriously. What do we do!? Shinobu!
What else? We just have to do it!
Shinobu! Get fired up!
Heh! We're about to stop a colony,
so why would a nuke scare me!? Let's do this!
The Cyber Beast Force is talking crazy...
Either way, crazy is crazy. ...Guess we have no choice...!
Using Gundam Unit 2 here... Dammit!
Calm down, Lieutenant Uraki. Zeon is staking everything on this operation.
It's only natural they'd go this far.
So are we, but... if they overwhelm us with numbers...!
6 minutes left...! We've already used half our time...!
There's still... a lot of 'em left, dammit.
No point panicking, but...
Impressive, Londo Bell! But this battle belongs to us, Zeon!
Not yet, it's not over yet!
With any fight, you never know until the very end!
Sure of victory in the middle of a fight... How naive.
If we lose here, I can't face the Gandor team... Let's go, Raideen!
Yeah. Who knows what Tetsuya would say. That's the scariest part.
Tetsuya does have a sharp tongue.
Koji's working hard on the ground... I'd be a laughingstock if I gave up.
We did promise to leave space to us.
But things ain't goin' our way. Can't we do somethin'?
Heh heh heh... Yes, the tide of the times now belongs to us, Zeon!
This too is for Lady Haman... Londo Bell! Prepare yourselves!
Well now, I think it's time I wrapped this up.
I'll stop it, no matter what...!
Heaven and earth, fire and water, grant me your power...!
Rom! You came!
Right on cue! You're such a star.
We defeated the Gyandlar forces that were heading this way...
All that's left is to deal with this colony.
You're as reckless as ever out here. ...Not that I mind that kind of fight.
Jim, let's help the people who are hurt!
Understood, my lady.
...We might actually pull this off, huh?
With Brother Rom and the others here... Yeah. It'll be fine...
(I knew it... it's about the Einst...)
6 minutes left! Eliminate the enemy before then, whatever it takes!
Ah! That's...!?
What...!? Judau! That's...!
This one...!
Hm!?
Excellen...
Ugh... You...!
Hey, Excellen, what's wrong?
Excellen! So you really can...!?
Doesn't look like they're here to help us...
Do they want the colony to fall!?
Lots of guests today. But... they're not the kind we can welcome.
Do these things want the colony drop to succeed!?
At the very least, damage to Earth doesn't seem to matter to them...!
It's an answer. ...This, too.
An answer...!? To what!?
...You'll understand too... in time. ...Once you awaken.
(What am I...!?)
Excellen! Please respond! Excellen!?
What are you all fussing about!?
These aren't the only enemies whose goals we can't figure out!
Well, that's how it is.
...Like that mysterious plant planet where Shapiro showed up.
True, we have no time to spare...
If this falls on Jaburo, there'll be no coming back from it...
Destroying them is top priority! I'm counting on you all.
What!? This Neue Ziel...!
Gatooo!!
Ngh... It didn't hold out to the point of no return,
but it should have held them up...
Until I see Stardust fulfilled with my own eyes, I cannot die!
It's over.
That was rough.
It's not over yet! Latch onto the colony and get inside!
I'll go. ...And, Lieutenant Uraki, will you come with me?
Huh? Ah, roger!
Good. Everyone else, be ready to pull out at any time!
Rom, what do we do?
Right. Now that we know what the Gyandlar are after...
Huh!? You figured something out!?
Bright, was it? Are you the leader of this unit?
I am. Why?
I have something to discuss. I'd like permission to come aboard.
...Hmm.
Captain, they can be trusted. And they seem to bring important news.
They helped us this much, so why are you hesitating!?
That's pretty gutless, Captain.
...All right. We'll open Catapult 2. Come aboard.
Thank you. Jet, Drill, Jim, Leina, let's go in.
...Excellen...?
